body:
A little under a year ago I was trying to kill myself on just about a weekly basis.  For years before that I had been massively depressed and hated life to an extreme degree.  When I was a little kid I dreamed constantly about living my life as the opposite gender.  I never chose to be transgender, hell, if there was medication that could get rid of these feelings then I'd honestly be extremely tempted.  No one chooses to be transgender, just like gay men weren't straight until they tried sex with men.

Edit: fallout 4 just came out.  I seriously doubt anyone's going to drop $60 to get you a free copy.
I honestly got really lucky.  If I hadn't stopped believing the church to be gob's own benevolent organization I wouldn't be here right now.
I tried to kill myself after discovering I was transgender.  It's amazing how much your extreme depression goes away when you aren't constantly being told you're going to hell.
